title: Muscle Growth Protocol
author: Michael_Hook_760923
desc: The purpose of Muscle Growth Protocol is to provide a structured, split-based training system that maximizes muscle growth and strength by targeting specific muscle groups efficiently through progressive, science-backed workouts.

ex.note: Set bench to incline; grip bar, lower to upper chest, press up fully; 2-0-2 tempo; rest 60–90s.
Lie on bench; hold dumbbells at chest, press up until arms extend, lower slowly; 2-0-2 tempo; rest 60–90s.
Sit on incline bench; grab cables, arms slightly bent; bring hands together over chest, control 3-1-3 tempo; rest 45–60s.
Stand side-on to cable; lift arm to shoulder height with slight bend, lower slowly; 2-1-2 tempo; rest 45–60s.
